findings.resolution: The shared no-argument service, FastAPI route and MCP tool accept no alias, path, target, scope, receipt, runner or campaign input. They remain typed unavailable until exact private host authority and phase-policy files are reviewed and pinned; non-production classification is independently derived at runtime.

One case-insensitive minimal environment builder now strips OpenAI, Azure, database, HMAC, token, auth-profile and Neo secret variables from Python CLI and preflight children while preserving executable lookup, OS, Salesforce credential-store, proxy and certificate controls.

Neo PostgreSQL adapters and migrations use a validated private configurable schema, ownership marker and schema-only search path; unrelated public tables, extensions and types are neither adopted nor rejected as Neo state.

Runtime status is forbidden in the acceptance profile, SATISFIED requirements require current durable receipt replay, and the successful real browser diagnostic remains diagnostic-only, release-ineligible and worth zero acceptance credit.

An offline-tested source-derived target producer and default-deny host planner bind complete REST, metadata, Apex, browser and dataset obligations without granting authority; omitted, extra, expired, wildcard or caller-widened targets block the plan.

The definition-only live profile requires independent mutation and pre-authorized recovery permits, post-dispatch restoration, reconciliation and quarantine; no current module or receipt authorizes deployment.

Receipt production now resolves an independently compiled durable expected-execution contract, rehashes embedded sanitized result bytes and their index, authenticates the runner with a configured key, and compares exact execution, version, assertion, predicate, cardinality, projection, metadata-member and dataset roots. Fabricated execution/version/predicate/result roots and signed-but-undurable expectation receipts fail focused tests.

The offline recovery executor snapshots and freezes the validated request before awaits, binds the expected-execution-contract root, atomically claims each permit once in durable storage, revalidates expiry/origin/org/actor immediately before action, and proves changed readback, exact restoration and cleanup. Production coordination remains read-only.

Independent adversarial review proved that candidate-controlled Node output could counterfeit test-runner event framing. Production NODE_TEST attestation is now refused before process creation, child-process permission is prohibited, and no signed local PASS can be minted. Exact host-pinned phase policy may defer only known non-runtime obligations for the fixed read-only baseline; the same obligations remain unresolved and blocking for candidate, deployment, restoration and release phases.
Ontology, source-profile and dependent policy and module pins were migrated atomically to a fixed point and verified through the default loaders.

The registry maps all 36 capabilities exactly once across seven product requirements and now names exact offline identity, transport, local-proof, phase-deferral, completed-baseline and cache-replay test nodes; every currentReceiptIds list remains empty and incomplete evidence stays nonaccepted.

The AUT catalog remains the separately generated source graph at 1,014 nodes and 3,700 edges. The Neo project index and knowledge graph were regenerated after live-read, concurrency, timezone and status-document changes at 289 files and 892 edges; the freshness check passed.
Astra found that bound graph verification could use a weaker partial verifier; verify_bound now delegates to strict complete-path replay and the focused post-fix regression set passed.

Base and candidate runs plus their bounded bundle publish atomically with exact identities; checkpoints remain explicitly outside that transaction and the resulting persistence gap blocks crash-safe resume claims.

Strict signed receipt validation, issuer separation, exact-byte append storage, expected-contract-aware production, realistic Salesforce CLI execution, host baseline composition and a shared no-argument service/API/MCP boundary pass offline integration tests. Machine-local authority was issued for read-only non-production campaigns. No SF-L03/SF-L04/SF-L05 passing receipt exists because the atomic campaign correctly blocked on current source versus deployed custom-REST schema drift; zero partial observations were accepted.
The fixed-alias real-org browser diagnostic passed with nonpersistent cleanup, but it emitted no signed receipt, performed no authorized apply and cannot satisfy SF-L06, SF-L07, SF-L09 or SF-C05.
Documentation separates deterministic and mocked foundations, the diagnostic browser pass and real candidate benchmark from product-owned live execution, durable receipts and release evidence.
Nine baseline/browser and six candidate/recovery gates remain distinct; fixtures, mocks, diagnostics, manual observations, baseline and check-only evidence cannot satisfy incompatible live phases.

The classification bootstrap now reconciles the active access-token subject twice through fixed userinfo reads, verifies the organization and active User by the observed IDs, and treats display alias as informational. REST execution validates the installed CLI status/result/statusCode/headers/body envelope, requires exact 2xx JSON bodies and normalizes API versions so source routes contain one version prefix.

Two product-owned read-only campaigns and a bounded seven-record diagnostic proved the endpoint is reachable with HTTP 200, but the deployed org returns schema 1.0.0 without the source-contract 1.1.0 history parent binding. Neo reports LIVE_READ_RESPONSE_INVALID, stores no partial passing observation and does not weaken the oracle. Check-only, deployment and restoration remain blocked pending separate current-task mutation authority.

Authoritative timestamp ingress rejects naive and unknown-offset values and normalizes known offsets to UTC before chronology and expiry checks. PostgreSQL sessions use UTC independently of server defaults; Git display timezone is not authority. Existing UTC canonical documents and signatures remain byte-identical. Astra's four-timezone PostgreSQL probe, DST-fold cases, expiry/revocation cases and full regression passed.

Required local evidence is aggregate-verified from exact durable artifact and receipt bytes before any Salesforce subprocess and reverified during composition and cached replay. Deferred read-only obligations remain typed unresolved objects bound to the source, candidate tree, host phase policy and exact SF-L03/SF-L04/SF-L05 gate set; they cannot become PASS or widen execution.
Controlled-root union and bootstrap-protected quality paths prevent working-tree policy changes from exempting themselves; this manifest lists every current controlled changed path.
The browser contract requires backend pipeline policy version 1.0.1 and rejects the stale 1.0.0 version.

A real-browser lost-click race was fixed by disabling candidate capture with a truthful preparing label until hydration; independent inspection found no weakened request, evidence, release, focus or keyboard assertion.
The final governance reviewer reported no P0 or new product defect; its stale-knowledge and missing-full-run procedural gaps were closed before approval.

The current full Python suite passed 1,547 tests with 3 explicit environment opt-in skips and zero failures in 1,521.73 seconds. TypeScript lint and the live-worker build passed; 46 Playwright worker/session/coordinator/healing/recovery tests and 21 Chromium dashboard E2E tests passed. Astra reported no P0/P1 timezone, concurrency or diagnostic-leakage finding. Live Salesforce acceptance remains separately blocked by the recorded deployed-schema drift.
Astra found the batch timeout covered only final process waiting; one bounded deadline now covers request writing, output draining and process completion.

Final Astra review found that a completed deferral-bearing baseline had only preflight coverage. A new real compiler/composer integration test now completes fixture SF-L01 through SF-L05, reconstructs all durable stores, replays with zero CLI dispatch, preserves every unresolved obligation and exact phase-policy identity, emits no local-validation PASS and remains release-ineligible.

Astra reproduced premature recovery, concurrent-drift overwrite, non-quiescent restart, dispatch-expiry and Metadata API named-test defects. The frozen offline adapter corrected those findings with exclusive ownership, independent durable fences, authenticated replay, quarantine and exact source-compiled preimage restoration; 150 tests passed with one Windows symlink-privilege skip. This is foundation evidence only.

Unresolved at the user-requested development stop: unknown nested keys can differentiate duplicate obligation hashes while selecting the same locator/control. The probe must enforce exact keys and align bounds with the Python contract before any live use. Eight focused tests pass but do not cover this final reproduced bypass.

Unresolved at the stop: Metadata API runs complete selected Apex classes while the source profile records method obligations. The bridge must source-capture and authorize each selected class's complete method inventory before check-only; NoTestRun or post-execution extra-method detection is not acceptable.

The new metadata recovery host factory and tests were interrupted before final independent review. They remain disabled and untrusted until exact transport, signed authority, durable frozen recovery evidence and no-retry behavior are rerun and reviewed.

The unavailable dashboard was traced to stopped API and Next.js processes. Both were restarted, the provider child received one coherent dotenv credential source without displaying the secret, API health reported provider and persistence ready, the dashboard rendered visibly and 21 Chromium tests passed. Durable launch supervision remains an operational enhancement.

All implementation agents were stopped on user instruction. No Salesforce metadata mutation, check-only, candidate deploy, healing acceptance or restore operation occurred. The current review status is IN_PROGRESS; interrupted files and live gaps are documented in Docs/21-development-stop-checkpoint-2026-09-11.md.

The public candidate specialist provider now exposes canonical ontology edge orientation to the model, verifies accepted relation proposals against exact evidence tuples, and normalizes benign provider ordering of string arrays before strict validation. Focused tests prove valid unordered responses pass while duplicate, unknown or malformed evidence remains rejected. This produces real model-backed fixture advisory evidence without weakening live Salesforce acceptance boundaries.

A generic host-local profile command now refreshes the short-lived browser diagnostic profile from current Salesforce CLI identity, derives only hashed org/actor bindings and pinned origins, writes only the ignored runtime profile, and prints only path, digest and expiry. It never prints or stores the frontdoor credential URL and does not issue signed live acceptance, mutation, deployment or release authority. The live browser smoke passed as diagnosticOnly=true and releaseEligible=false.

Astra found that the first live-operator advisory draft dispatched a direct Salesforce CLI diagnostic after only requiring an alias. The implementation now removes that public alias-only shortcut, projects the existing governed live-baseline boundary when available, blocks otherwise, adds a bounded CLI timeout, forbids all caller scope at the endpoint, and requires at least one model-backed specialist advisory capture before HTTP success. The slice remains diagnostic/advisory-only and current real execution is blocked by an empty Salesforce app candidate rather than substituting fixture evidence.

A real local-Git AUT locator-drift candidate now runs through the candidate assurance path with OpenAI-backed specialist dispatch, producing two side analyses and six specialist captures. The implementation preserves release-ineligible advisory status, adds current source-foundation context gap allowlisting, increases bounded specialist artifact capacity for graph-backed captures, deduplicates equivalent workflow gaps before enforcing finite result limits, and keeps this evidence separate from live Salesforce deployment/browser/restoration gates.

The active two-hour run uses the latest timeboxed method as the current scope authority: one demo capability at a time, real LLM/live Salesforce evidence where available, maximum three retries per subtask, and deferral of broad production hardening unless needed for safety, credential protection, mutation authority or truthful claims. The current operator demo is documented as a truthful sequence of real local AUT candidate LLM advisory, live Salesforce read proof and live headless browser diagnostic proof; deployed-candidate mutation, restoration/reconciliation, full live campaign gates, Chroma/GraphRAG breadth and non-route UI polish are deferred.

Astra found that the live Salesforce diagnostic and candidate LLM advisory were adjacent rather than evidence-bound in one context pack. The operator advisory path now passes the governed live diagnostic into candidate analysis, compiles a source-bound non-authorizing live-read unresolved fragment into the specialist GraphContextPack, counts LLM advisory availability only when verifier-accepted proposals exist, and keeps blocked diagnostics from carrying read evidence. Focused regression passed 28 tests. Deployment remains blocked until exact LWC candidate restore/reconciliation support exists.

The user-authorized lightweight preimage archive closed the immediate demo mutation blocker for the exact Workbench LWC candidate. The live preimage was archived under an operation id with sanitized hashes, check-only succeeded, the scoped LWC candidate deployed, a new fixed-scope read-only Playwright CLI verified one deployed `lightning-button[data-action="save-evaluate-live"]`, and the archived preimage was restored and reconciled by SHA-256. The path remains diagnostic/demo-scoped and does not claim complete signed campaign acceptance.

The blueprint review found the useful near-term addition was not a new architecture but a small runtime execution/evaluation envelope. The live candidate readback CLI now emits sanitized step context, selected strategy, expected postcondition and per-attempt receipts, caps retries at three, retries only bounded readback failures after browser/context cleanup, and avoids raw paths, selectors, marker values, sessions or org payloads. Focused browser build and 23 Playwright tests passed.

The live campaign status projection now exposes the complete required gate matrix with each gate's kind, receipt type, accepted evidence phase, required-for-completion flag, locally valid count and missing required gate IDs. Completion and release fields remain false/zero unless the signed durable campaign validates all required gates, so scoped LWC deploy/readback/restore evidence cannot be misrepresented as full live Salesforce acceptance. Focused status/API tests passed 10/10.

Protected push surfaced browser TypeScript regressions after the Python suite passed. Browser recovery now narrows recovery action roles to non-null Playwright roles before getByRole use, and the coordinator test fixtures type candidate lifecycle arrays explicitly. Browser lint and live browser build pass without changing browser authority, mutation, or acceptance behavior.
